column3: My voice is explicitly repeated before each appeal.
When, rather than although, introduces the spirit’s faintness.
The person lacking is one who recognizes me. The escape place has perished or been lost.
I have cried and I have said are both expressed as completed actions.
I have become very low describes the speaker’s state.
The purpose is thanksgiving to Your name, and the following clause describes Your dealing bountifully with me.
